summary: Unilever PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting routine share repurchases under its existing buyback programme. Between 26-29 May 2026, Unilever purchased 3,249,348 ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and other venues at a volume-weighted average price of ~4,251.80 GBp per share (approx. £138M total). The shares will be held in treasury, reducing the share count from ~2,163.5M to ~2,163.5M excluding 21.7M treasury shares. This is a standard routine open-market buyback, not a tender offer or issuer self-tender. No special-situation catalyst or structural change is present. Watch for continued execution and potential impact on EPS.
